name: python-complexity
description: Measure per-function cyclomatic (ruff C901) and cognitive (complexipy) complexity in Python to find refactor targets, with no project install. Use when asking which functions to refactor first, whether a function is too complex, where the worst code in a module is, when triaging a legacy codebase, or when verifying a refactor actually reduced complexity. Teaches reading the two metrics as a pair and the silent-failure modes that make a clean run a lie.
